plaatsen.tekst: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall

For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.
Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite
Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.
And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found
In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
